@sepo-agent /answer 

Also in general, can our triage dynamically include other routes when we build them as well?

comments.body:
Short answer: **not in the dispatch prompt right now**.

`orchestrate` is supported elsewhere: explicit `/orchestrate` is recognized in the triage code, validated by policy, tested, and routed by `agent-router.yml`. But the model-facing dispatch prompt only lists `answer`, `implement`, `fix-pr`, `review`, `create-action`, and `unsupported`, so free-form triage is not currently instructed to choose `orchestrate`.

Relevant files:

- Dispatch prompt omits `orchestrate`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2e52123e13a5fd266af3ff4eeb90f1d2bc4b4e27/.github/prompts/agent-dispatch.md#L10-L23
- Route validator includes `orchestrate`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2e52123e13a5fd266af3ff4eeb90f1d2bc4b4e27/.agent/src/triage.ts#L12-L20
- Explicit slash commands include `/orchestrate`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2e52123e13a5fd266af3ff4eeb90f1d2bc4b4e27/.agent/src/triage.ts#L31-L31
- Router has an `orchestrate` job: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2e52123e13a5fd266af3ff4eeb90f1d2bc4b4e27/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L655-L700

For dynamic route inclusion: **yes, we can make that happen, but it is not currently dynamic**. Route knowledge is duplicated across the prompt, `ROUTES`, explicit command parsing, label mapping, dispatch policy, tests, docs, and workflow jobs.

Implementation approach I’d recommend:

1. Add a central route registry, probably under `.agent/src/routes.ts`, containing route id, prompt description, target-kind constraints, approval behavior, explicit command/label support, and whether it should appear in model triage.
2. Generate or inject the dispatch prompt route list from that registry.
3. Refactor `triage.ts` to validate routes and explicit commands from the same registry.
4. Keep workflow dispatch explicit unless we add a generic route dispatcher, because GitHub Actions job graphs are mostly static.
5. Add tests that fail if the dispatch prompt, route validator, explicit routes, and label routes drift again.

So the immediate fix would be to add `orchestrate` to `agent-dispatch.md`; the more durable fix is a shared route catalog that renders the triage options dynamically.
